justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/matcher/FieldTypeMatcher.java`, `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/matcher/ElementMatchers.java`, and `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/matcher/FieldTypeMatcherTest.java`. The class is only 55 lines and has a single responsibility: one private field, one constructor, one `doMatch` method that delegates to `target.getType()`, and one `toString()`. `ElementMatchers.genericFieldType(...)` just instantiates it, and the test covers only the single matching behavior. This is a small, cohesive adapter, not a class with multiple separable responsibilities.
